title: Task 1.2: Informal Letter Advising a Friend on Organizing a Community Event in the Countryside

body.frame: G. Provide Instruction / Suggestion (I believe you should...)
body.reason: Clear information and warm face-to-face invitations help bring families of all ages together.
body.requirement: Advise how to attract local villagers to the event
